# Release and outcome record

Prepare the applicable details before requesting any authority still missing.
This document does not authorize external effects or ongoing automation.

- **Verified local revision:** Spec, criterion IDs, fresh receipt paths and blockers.
- **Target and authority:** Environment, proposed change, actual owner authorization
  and any still-required connection. Never include credential values.
- **Release identity:** Provider request/deployment ID and verified deployed revision.
  A timeout after submission is an unknown outcome until reconciled; do not blindly retry.
- **Data and recovery:** Migration order, backup/restore or rollback plan and evidence.
- **Post-release journey:** Meaningful task on the recorded deployment, expected
  behavior, observed result and integration limitations.
- **Outcome experiment:** Buyer/channel hypothesis, activation/retention or task
  success measure, denominator, observation window and stop/continue condition.
- **Feedback → change:** Source, reproducible problem, criterion/regression,
  bounded next task, verified release and later customer outcome.
- **Operating limits:** Requested monitoring/maintenance, permitted actions,
  spending/time bounds and escalation point. Unknown usage/cost stays unknown.
